title: Other devices shows which host you are connected to
text: When you open Seismic's configuration on a phone or another computer, the Other devices section used to show only its intro and looked like it was still loading. Now an alert box with a cloud icon names the machine Seismic runs on ("Connected to" with the host's name). In the same box, a hint explains that new devices are added from the host's own Seismic, on that machine, and links to the docs.
